transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the planned release of the machine-learning toolkit this Friday. As we all know, the package includes source code, trained model weights, a sample training corpus, and performance benchmarks. Before I can give my final legal approval, I need to hear from each of our subject-matter counsel — open-source, privacy, commercial-contracts, and export. Can we go around and get status updates from each of you on your review findings?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical finding from my review. I examined the dependency manifest and confirmed that the toolkit links to a core library distributed only under AGPL-3.0. I've kept the full dependency analysis in my release-gate working papers, but this is a material issue that needs to be resolved before approval.

commitments.detail: Release package will be licensed under AGPL-3.0-only and corresponding source for linked toolkit code will be provided, per the AGPL-3.0 core library dependency.
Training corpus will be excluded from the public release package due to 37 customer support records containing personal data.
Benchmark package will be excluded from the public release due to customer-specific results prohibited from public disclosure under enterprise-customer agreements.
Model weights downloads will be restricted to users in the United States and Canada, and the repository will display an export-control notice.
